Usage: yantra usage [options]

Summarize task volume and cost from the history index

Options:
  --type <type>   filter by task type (ask|research|run|do)
  --since <when>  only tasks since a date (YYYY-MM-DD) or age (e.g. 7d, 24h)
  --json          emit JSON instead of a table (default: false)
  --debug         verbose logging on stderr (default: false)
  -h, --help      display help for command
